Home.hero_subtitle: Cargo Posted. Right Transport. Deal Closed.
Home.hero_body: The digital marketplace that connects shippers and transporters in one place. Artificial Intelligence finds the right transport for every load — and vice versa. Freight payment is made directly into an Escrow Account managed by a partner bank. Post cargo, negotiate, track your freight in real time, make payments and receive funds securely — without intermediaries or unnecessary complexity.
Home.product_demo_desc: Browse representative listings from the NexCargo marketplace. Create an account to interact with real cargo opportunities.
Home.how_step_shipper_1_desc: Enter origin, destination, cargo type, weight, and preferred date.
Home.how_step_shipper_2_desc: Transporters discover your cargo and submit their price proposals.
Home.how_step_shipper_3_desc: Review the offers, accept the best option, and proceed to contracting.
Home.how_step_transporter_1_desc: Explore available cargo that matches your route and capacity.
Home.how_step_transporter_2_desc: Propose your prices for cargo compatible with your vehicle.
Home.how_step_transporter_3_desc: Sign the contract, perform the transport, and complete the delivery.
Home.for_shipper_desc: Post cargo with complete route and date details. Receive price proposals from transporters, compare options, and proceed through structured contracting flows, all through your personalized Dashboard.
Home.shipper_features_compare: Compare and select the best offer
Home.for_transporter_desc: Discover cargo that matches your preferred routes and vehicle capacity. Submit your price proposals, get hired, and manage your operations, all through your personalized Dashboard.
Home.feature_listings_desc: Post and manage cargo with complete route, weight, preferred date, and vehicle requirement details.
Home.feature_matching_desc: Connects cargo requirements with suitable transport capacity based on route, capacity, and reliability.
Home.feature_tracking_desc: Track your shipment's location, route, and status in real time with live GPS tracking from departure to delivery.
Home.feature_payment_desc: The Shipper pays directly into the Escrow Account managed by the partner bank, using available payment methods. The funds are released after delivery is confirmed.
Home.feature_ai_desc: AI-supported decision assistance for freight matching, routing suggestions, and operational optimization.
Home.feature_documents_desc: Documents integrated into cargo, contracting, and operational workflows, including electronic delivery orders and compliance records.
Home.feature_notifications_desc: Operational communication throughout the transport lifecycle — from posting through delivery confirmation.
Home.feature_multilang_desc: Full Portuguese and English interface supporting logistics operations in Mozambique and the region.
Home.trust_no_custody_desc: We connect market participants without interfering in the operation. We are the technology layer for logistics coordination, not a carrier.
Home.trust_responsibility_desc: Transport execution and management belong exclusively to the Transporter. NexCargo provides the digital infrastructure; the fleet belongs to the operator.
Home.trust_no_custody_funds_desc: NexCargo does not hold customer funds. The financial architecture processes funds exclusively through duly regulated banking and payment partners.
Home.trust_region_desc: Built from the ground up for the logistics realities of Mozambique, with a native Portuguese interface and architecture prepared for the regional SADC corridor.
Home.moz_title: Built in Mozambique. Designed for the region.
Home.moz_desc: NexCargo was built to address the logistics challenges of Mozambique and the needs of transport corridors across Southern Africa. The platform provides a native Portuguese experience and is designed to support domestic and cross-border transport operations across the SADC region.
Home.final_section_title: Ready to move your first cargo?
Home.final_shipper_line: Publish your cargo and reach qualified transporters.
Home.final_transporter_line: Discover new freight opportunities along your routes.
Home.footer_brand_desc: A neutral freight marketplace built for Mozambique and the SADC region.
